text:
alice.chen: Heads-up — I sketched a narrower fallback/exceptions proposal for the rollout UX. Need quick feedback before I add it to the console mockups.

ben_kim: quick q — is this about default behavior for hosted customers or the Dedicated/Private rollouts too?

alice.chen: both. Defaults for hosted, but console options for Dedicated/Private where teams can relax policies.

carol_m: put the defaults as conservative safe-first. Prefer degrade to a compatible smaller model rather than returning 5xx. :+1:

danielle: agreeing. Also want clear telemetry flag so we can tie any quality regressions to specific rollout windows.

esme_sre: We need deterministic triggers. Random thresholds cause paging at 2am. Proposal?

alice.chen: rough triggers in the doc: latency_p50>1200ms for 3m OR error_5xx_rate>0.8% over 5m. Also a success-rate drop (>=5% drop vs baseline) as a safety net.

ben_kim: Those sound reasonable. Can we allow per-route overrides in the console? Some routes are best-effort (embeds) others are strict (auth).

alice.chen: yes — per-route override with inheritance from project->route. Console UI would show current effective policy.

carol_m: audit needs to record: trigger_reason, snapshot of input prompt length distribution, model_version_before/after, and sample outputs. Also sample size and sampling-rate.

danielle: on sampling — we should sample 100% for the first 5m after any auto-fallback, then drop to configurable percentage (default 5%).

esme_sre: 100% could be heavy for high-throughput routes. Maybe make 100% only for routes with QPS<10, otherwise 10%?

ben_kim: (typo) ben_kim: ^ agree with esme. Also need a cost-estimate indicator in the console so PMs can see expected token cost delta when falling back to quantized model.

alice.chen: good call. Add a small cost delta widget in the rollout preview.

carol_m: UX question — how do operators acknowledge an auto-fallback? We should have a one-click ack in the console to mark investigations in the audit log.

danielle: ack button + tagging + optional runbook link. That flows into postmortems.

esme_sre: We should also expose a safe-override grief? e.g., manual hard-fail if fallback is causing worse results. Manual override should require second-factor.

alice.chen: manual override gating (2FA) is planned for Dedicated/Private only. Hosted gets soft-override: route-level disable for 15m with Audit.

runtime-bot: AUTO-FALLBACK detected on project:redwood-prod route:chat/complete reason: latency_p50>1200ms  (ts=1979004380)

ben_kim: example payload from runtime-bot looks good. Can it include a link to the trace/span and model metrics?

runtime-bot: yes, will include trace url and small perf snapshot.

carol_m: back to telemetry — we need a dashboard tile that shows all auto-fallback events over time, grouped by trigger type, and a drilldown to sample outputs with diff view (before vs after).

danielle: and alerting — paged alert only if fallback is to 'return-5xx' or if fallback rate > 2% of total requests for >10m. Low-noise alerts otherwise.

esme_sre: Can we make the UI highlight routes where fallback is masking a real regression? i.e., if fallback rate is high but audit-sampled quality drop is also high, raise priority.

alice.chen: that's the idea. We'll show a risk score (0-1) combining fallback rate, delta in eval metrics, and unexpected prompt changes.

ben_kim: one more API detail — the internal rollouts API should expose a /simulate endpoint that runs the policy against historical traffic and returns predicted fallback counts and cost delta. Very helpful before enabling auto.

alice.chen: love it. I'll add simulate to the API surface.

carol_m: UX deliverable checklist for me: console mock of policy editor, rollout preview with cost delta, audit timeline, drilldown sample diff. Will send PR with screenshots.

alice.chen: thanks. I'll update the spec with esme's sampling rules and danielle's ack flow.

deploy-bot: PR #4123 opened by carol_m: "fallback-exceptions-console-mockups" — CI checks running.

alice.chen: will review PR today. If no blockers, let's land and ship a beta to dev-team for testing next week.

esme_sre: ping me when beta hits dev, I'll run chaos latency tests. :muscle:

ben_kim: noted — I'll prototype /simulate this afternoon.

alice.chen: sweet. thanks everyone.
